newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - CPI RISES 4.4 PCT IN Q2.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - CPI RISES 4.4 PCT IN Q2.

text.p: Estonian consumer prices rose by 4.4 percent in the second quarter, compared to a rise of three percent the previous quarter, the statistics office said on Monday.
Compared to the second quarter of 1996, consumer prices were up an average 10.3 percent, it added in a statement.
Goods inflation was 2.7 percent, including a rise in food products by 2.5 percent and a rise in non-food by 3.1 percent.
A rise in housing costs and in telephone and transport services had the biggest impact on the consumer price index increase in the second quarter, the office said.
